issue.title: Recognize Z.AI API keys in OpenCode auth checks
issue.description: The current OpenCode provider's llm_auth_evidence recognizes several API-key environment variables but omits ZHIPU_API_KEY. OpenCode's current native Z.AI and Z.AI Coding Plan catalogs use ZHIPU_API_KEY, so a headless environment-variable configuration can work while sase doctor -C llm.auth reports no auth evidence. Add ZHIPU_API_KEY to the OpenCode auth evidence list and cover it with the existing provider/doctor tests and docs where appropriate.
